summary: Represents validation results for assessment processing, specifically capturing common invalid states.
purpose: To indicate specific validation failures in assessment logic, such as unpaired interim/final assessments, issues with instructors and supervisors, and exceeded maximums.

entities.name: AssessmentValidationResult
entities.description: Class representing the result of validation checks applied during assessment operations.

fields.name: InterimWithoutFinal
fields.description: True if an interim assessment exists without a corresponding final assessment; used for validation.

fields.name: InstructorsAndSupervisors
fields.description: Validation state involving instructor and supervisor associations on assessments.

fields.name: AssessmentMaximumExceeded
fields.description: True if assessment maximum constraints are violated.

workflows.name: Assessment Validation
steps: Validate that interim assessments are paired with finals.

business_rules: An interim assessment must be paired with a final assessment.
Instructor and supervisor assignments must conform to configuration.
The maximum number of assessments must not be exceeded.
validations: InterimWithoutFinal: Fails if interim assessment is missing a final.
InstructorsAndSupervisors: Fails if assignment rules for instructors/supervisors are violated.
AssessmentMaximumExceeded: Fails if assessment count exceeds allowed maximum.
system_behavior: Sets the respective boolean field to true if a specific validation fails during assessment processing.
